claims: Banana Ball was created by the Savannah Bananas.
Banana Ball has a two-hour time limit.
In Banana Ball, batters cannot bunt.
In Banana Ball, batters cannot step out of the box.
In Banana Ball, foul balls caught by fans in the stands are counted as outs.
Banana Ball features high-energy fan interaction.
In Banana Ball, points are awarded per inning.
In Banana Ball, the team with the most runs in an inning wins one point.
In Banana Ball, all runs count in the final inning.
In Banana Ball, batters can steal first base at any time, including on wild pitches or passed balls.
In Banana Ball, if tied after two hours, a showdown resolves the game.
A Banana Ball showdown is a 1-on-1 batter vs. pitcher.
In Banana Ball, a team can choose any hitter in their lineup to bat once per game.
Starting May 8, 2026, 15 exclusive Banana Ball games will air on truTV and HBO Max.
2026 Banana Ball World Tour games will be at venues like Coors Field, Kauffman Stadium, and Gillette Stadium.
The 2026 Banana Ball World Tour features the Savannah Bananas, Party Animals, and Texas Tailgaters.
Tickets for the 2026 Banana Ball World Tour are sold via an official lottery system on the Savannah Bananas website.
